# cpputils — C++ utility library

## What this is

`collectdata/cpputils/` is a **git submodule** (upstream `https://github.com/majorkingleo/cpputils.git`) providing a general-purpose C++ utility library, almost all in namespace `Tools`. It is header-heavy, with only a handful of `.cc` files compiled into two static libs by the parent project's autotools build:

- `cpputils/cpputilsshared/libcpputilsshared.a`
- `cpputils/cpputilsshared/cpputilsformat/libcpputilsformat.a`

License: GPL (`COPYING`) with an explicit linking exception (`COPYING.exception`).

## Directory map

| Path | Contents |
|------|----------|
| `cpputilsshared/` | Core headers + compiled `.cc`: `Ref`, `EnumRange`, `string_utils`, `pairs`, `map_utils`, `iterator`, `arg`, `cppdir`, `leoini`, `xml`, `backtrace`, `stderr_exception`, `file_option`, static containers, `utf8` |
| `cpputilsshared/cpputilsformat/` | `Tools::format`/`wformat` + `CFormat`, `static_format` → `libcpputilsformat.a` |
| `io/` | Console I/O: `Debug`/`x_debug`/`CPPDEBUG`, `OutDebug`, `ColoredOutput`, `ConvertEncoding`, `DetectLocale`, `ReadFile` (BOM-aware) |
| `thread/` | `Tools::Thread` + `Mutex` + `do_sleep` (pthread/Win32), gated by `TOOLS_USE_THREADS` |
| `fox/` | FOX Toolkit GUI widgets/theming (`theme.h`), gated by `TOOLS_USE_GUI` |
| `utf8/` | Vendored `utf8-cpp` (Nemanja Trifunovic) core headers |

## Key components

### Formatting (`cpputilsformat/`)
- `format("Hello %s, I have $05d$ in my pocket", "world", 5)` — type-safe `sprintf` returning `std::string`; `wformat` for `std::wstring`.
- `$...$` encloses printf-style flags (width/precision). `Tools::Format::CFormat` parses the specifiers.
- `format.h` selects `format1.h` (pre-C++11) or `format2.h`/`wformat2.h` (C++11 variadic templates).
- `static_format.h` (`Tools::StaticFormat`) formats into a caller-provided `std::span`/static buffer with **no heap**.

### Smart pointer (`ref.h`)
- `Tools::Ref<T>` — simple intrusive-style reference-counting pointer (no array support, `BadRef` exception). Used everywhere in `arg.h` and `xml.h`.

### No-heap containers (`cpputilsshared/`)
- `static_vector<T,N>` (`std::pmr::vector<T>` over a `std::array<std::byte,…>` + `monotonic_buffer_resource`).
- `static_string`, `static_basic_string<N,CharT,…>` (out-of-range policy functor: cut or throw).
- `static_list<T,N>` — `std::list`-like with stable iterators, built on `static_vector<std::optional<T>,N>`.
- `CyclicArray<T,N>` — ring buffer; `push_back(v, discard_front=false)` throws when full unless discarding.
- `span_vector<T>` — `std::vector` interface over an external `std::span` (no ownership).
- `basic_string_adapter` / `string_adapter.h` — string over any container/span.

### String utilities (`string_utils.h`)
- `s2x<T>(s)` / `s2x<T>(s, init)` — string→any; `x2s(v)` / `x2ws(v)` — any→string.
- `strip`, `strip_leading`, `strip_trailing`, `toupper`, `tolower`, `is_int`, `s2bool`.
- `split_simple`, `split_string`, `split_and_strip_simple` (+ C++17 `*_view` variants).
- `Pairs`/`WPairs` (`pairs.h`) locate quoted regions in text; `map_utils.h` adds `getKeySet`/`getKeySetAsVector`.

### Command-line parsing (`arg.h`, `file_option.h`)
- `Tools::Arg::Arg` with `addPrefix`, `setMinMatch`, `parse()`, `getHelp()`.
- `Rule` hierarchy: `OptionNameRule`, `IsOptionRule`, `IsValueRule`, `IsBoolRule`, `AnyStringRule`, `IsIntRule`, `EmptyOptionNameRule`.
- `Option` hierarchy: `BoolOption`, `StringOption`, `EnumOption`, `EmptyStringOption`, `FlagOption`, `IntOption`; file-aware `FileOption`/`EmptyFileOption` (in `file_option.h`).
- `OptionChain` groups options with `setContinueOnMatch/Fail`.

### Misc (`cpputilsshared/`)
- `EnumRange<E>` (`range.h`) — bounds-checked enum wrapper using `FIRST__`/`LAST__`; aborts when exceptions are disabled.
- `Tools::CppDir` (`cppdir.h`) — file/dir type checks (behind `DISABLE_CPPUTILS_CPPDIR`).
- `Tools::Leo::Ini` (`leoini.h`) — INI read/write.
- `Tools::XML` (`xml.h`) — lightweight XML-like reader.
- `Tools::BackTrace` (`backtrace.h`) — manual push/pop ticket stack.
- `StderrException` + `STDERR_EXCEPTION(what)` macro (`stderr_exception.h`) — prints `file:line message` to stderr at throw time.
- `iterator.h` (`Iterator`), `TupleReverse.h`, `counting_span.h`, `static_debug_exception.h`.

### I/O, thread, GUI (`io/`, `thread/`, `fox/`)
- `io/CpputilsDebug.h`: `Tools::Debug` interface, global `Tools::x_debug`, `CPPDEBUG(x)` macro (compiles out under `NDEBUG`).
- `io/OutDebug.h`: colored console debug sink; `io/ColoredOutput.h`: ANSI color wrapper.
- `io/ConvertEncoding.h` (iconv), `io/DetectLocale.h`, `io/read_file.h` (`ReadFile`, BOM detection).
- `thread/thread.h`: `Tools::Thread`, `Mutex`, `do_sleep` — only when `TOOLS_USE_THREADS` is defined.
- `fox/theme.h`: FOX widgets (`ThemeButton`, `ThemeTextField`, `ThemeComboBox`, `init_theme`) — only when `TOOLS_USE_GUI`.

## Configuration macros (`tools_config.h`)

Headers gate features via `tools_config.h` (in the parent `collectdata/tools/`, see `tools_config.h.example`):

- `NOWAMAS` — defined by the parent `Makefile.am` (`-DNOWAMAS`); makes `ref.h` include `tools_config.h`.
- `TOOLS_USE_THREADS` → enables `thread/thread.h`; `TOOLS_USE_GUI` → enables `fox/theme.h`.
- `DISABLE_CPPUTILS_CPPDIR`, `DISABLE_CPPUTILS_READFILE`, `DISABLE_CPPUTILS_DETECT_LOCALE` — trim dependencies.
- `TOOLS_USE_GLOBAL_COUNT` — enables a global `Ref` counter.
- Exception-free builds: `#if __cpp_exceptions > 0` guards throw paths with `std::abort()` fallback.

## Include style

In the parent project (`collectdata/Makefile.am`) the include dirs are added via `AM_CPPFLAGS`, so cpputils headers are included with **angle brackets**: `<arg.h>`, `<format.h>`, `<string_utils.h>`, `<stderr_exception.h>`, `<CpputilsDebug.h>`. `io/`, `thread/`, `fox/` headers use relative `"../../../tools_config.h"` includes, so add their directory to the include path when using them.

## Common tasks

### Add a new option to a CLI tool using `Tools::Arg`
1. `#include <arg.h>` and create `Tools::Arg::Arg arg(argc, argv)`.
2. `arg.addPrefix("-"); arg.addPrefix("--"); arg.setMinMatch(1);`
3. Declare e.g. `Arg::FlagOption o_foo("foo");` (or `IntOption`, `StringOption`), optionally `addName`, `setDescription`, `setRequired`.
4. Register with `arg.addOptionR(&o_foo)` or attach to an `Arg::OptionChain`.
5. Call `arg.parse()`, then branch on `o_foo.getState()` / `isSet()`.

### Format a string safely
```cpp
#include <format.h>
std::string s = Tools::format("%s has %02d entries", name, count); // %02d, $05d$ style
```
Use `Tools::StaticFormat` when the output must not allocate.

### Convert between string and number
```cpp
#include <string_utils.h>
int    n = Tools::s2x<int>("42", 0);
std::string s = Tools::x2s(3.14);
auto parts = Tools::split_and_strip_simple(line, ";");
```

### Throw an error with location
```cpp
#include <stderr_exception.h>
throw STDERR_EXCEPTION("cannot parse records");
```

### Use a no-heap buffer
```cpp
#include <static_vector.h>
Tools::static_vector<int, 32> buf; // capacity 32, no heap
```

## Gotchas

- **This is a submodule.** Edits here belong to the `majorkingleo/cpputils` repo; commit them there, then bump the submodule pointer in the parent repo (`git add collectdata/cpputils`). Clone with `--recurse-submodules`.
- `collectdata/` has **local copies** of some cpputils files at its top level (`colored_output.cc/h`, `OutDebug.cc/h`, `file_option.cc/h`) that are what `collectdata` actually compiles. Don't edit one and expect the other to change.
- Everything lives in namespace `Tools` (sub-namespaces: `Arg`, `Format`, `Format2`, `StaticFormat`, `CppDir`, `Leo`, `XML`, `FastDelivery`, `TupleHelper`).
- C++ standard gates behavior: C++17 enables `string_view` split functions; C++20 enables `constexpr` in `static_vector`; pre-C++11 uses `format1`.
- `static_string`/`static_vector` include `<CpputilsDebug.h>` and `<format.h>`; `io/` headers require their own `-I` directory.
- Comments and author tags are largely in German; original authors are Martin Oberzalek and Anton Paar GmbH (`static_*` containers).
- Keep `__cpp_exceptions` guards intact when touching containers — they support exception-free builds via `std::abort()`.
- `CyclicArray::push_back` throws `std::out_of_range` when full and `discard_front == false`; the overloads differ slightly in their abort paths, so mirror both when editing.
